title: W07c: worker setup and feasibility gate fixtures
description: Provide the worker setup path and the fixtures that must pass before worker execution touches a real project: host identity supplied correctly for normal and delegated workers; parallel sessions in one profile staying separate; the native client dispatching the selected project server in the correct profile scope; per-call worker context reaching the correct core invocation; resumes and reconnects never reusing another binding; disabled plugins, absent allowlists and unavailable context producing refusal; and runtime plugin registration interoperating with packaged desktop and backend targets.
acceptance: Every gate of plan 12.5 has a passing fixture, and a failing gate blocks worker execution with the blocker recorded instead of a fallback.
No gate is satisfied by falling back to a startup working directory, one profile per worker, or a Hermes core modification.
The fixtures run against a temporary ledger and a temporary Hermes home and leave both unchanged.
notes: Gate failure is recorded for a separate design decision rather than silently choosing another architecture.
